calculation: composition-dependent pp evolution with instantaneous convective mixing
nuclear_physics: Solar Fusion II quadrature; finite-degeneracy Salpeter--Van Horn screening
opacity: AESOPUS/TOPS X/Z family, number-density isotope mapping; GS98 metal proxy
atmosphere: TLUSTY208/SYNSPEC54 helium-rich gas atmospheres; candidate grid
atmosphere_grid_approximation: LTE plane-parallel gas, GS98 metal proxy, source molecular EOS; effective helium mass, isotope cross sections and broadening approximated; no condensates or irradiation
nuclear_limitations: reduced pp network: no pep, hep, ppIII or CNO; SFII pp curvature omitted; SVH approximate, not derived from FreeEOS; modern screening requires zeta<=.2
mass_basis: conserved baryonic mass; nuclear rest mass release accounted in energy, Newtonian gravity
age_origin: specified static composition, not age since formation
eos: FreeEOS potential family; He3 number-density mapping; metals as He4
limitations: source domains enforced; He isotope cross sections approximated, GS98 metals; atmosphere/EOS/opacity source mixture approximations; Schwarzschild criterion, no Ledoux/diffusion/remeshing; conduction mixture and envelope join approximations
note: First coupled non-grey trial, using the complete 24-cell Teff2600/2800 subset of the corrected-Jacobian family. The final full family includes additional warmer cells.
